notes.title: Some more fixes...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843345/06bc37794a11b3994862ef993adca18980a50aec.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

It's been a hot minute since our last update but we've been keeping an eye on the bug reports in the Steam forums, and made time to get some of those newer QOL & bug fixes in. Special shoutout to @bobjonesfu for all the fantastic in-depth bug reporting! We tried to address everything so this build has the following changes:

[list]
[*] fixed: The Image in the gallery where Mallory is hiding in your bed, cycles to the image where she smiles at you 
[*] fixed: You can press the space button to reset the gallery cycling
[*] fixed: You can continue dialogue with the space button even while the gallery is pulled up, the save screen is up, the load screen is up, the menu button is up, the options menu is up, etc.
[*] fixed: Right-clicking makes a noise and makes the dialogue arrow shrink as if it was clicked but doesn't continue dialogue
[*] fixed: Putting in a ridiculously long name doesn't look good in the history when your character says multiple things in a row as the name starts to overlap itself
[*] fixed: If you load while in game to a save that's at a point without music (like the beginning of chapter 6) the music that is currently playing will continue there (excluding the title screen music)
[/list]

Once again we thank you all for enjoying our game and helping us track down any improvements that can be made :) You're the best!!

We're still working on some special things related to Cabin Fever, so look forward to future news from us! Exciting stuff is in the works...

Love you so hard,
~The Pandas

notes.title: Little Additions and Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843345/b82df534974b5a2a52c08d540b5ac8cb4546d101.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

Got another update for ya! This one has more polish improvements suggested by players in the Steam forums :)

notes.title: A Few More Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843345/2d4cbff5035875e1060af99c26ae3337910ecdc6.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps,

This is just a quick update to let you know what we've addressed in the latest version of Cabin Fever! First and foremost, we've added extra save slots - we're sure lots of you will be happy about that! Secondly, we've corrected a number of bugs that were being reported. Choices no longer stack across multiple games, auto-mode no longer persists across multiple games, and we also fixed an issue where the music wasn't playing on the title screen in certain situations.

As always, thank you so much for all your feedback! You should be able to play the game to its fullest extent now, so go forth and enjoy all those story paths and endings.

We love you so hard!
The Pandas

notes.title: As Requested By You!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843345/98626c8f69657d1c86fd1f7b3e3bfd8b0075b707.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

First of all, shout out to all the keeners who’ve been playing through Cabin Fever and telling us what’s good and what needs fixing! We love your feedback, and we’ve gone ahead and implemented a bunch of fan-suggested improvements to hopefully make your gaming experience that much better.

What are these improvements, you ask? Well, here’s a list!

[list]
[*] We added a LOAD GAME shortcut to the in-game menu at the bottom of the screen.
[*] We changed some text colors to better distinguish between save/load pages.
[*] You can now advance the dialogue by clicking anywhere on the screen, not just in the speech box/on the arrow button.
[*] There’s now a SKIP button, so you can breeze through text you’ve already read!!! This will make it way easier to explore all the different story paths.
[/list]

That’s about it, along with some small miscellaneous bug fixes. Please consider leaving us a quick positive review if you’re enjoying the game! It really helps us out and we appreciate it sooo much. And feel free to keep throwing your suggestions at us, too!

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

P.S. The artwork in this news post's banner was made by the lovely [url=https://www.deviantart.com/murmoruno]Mur Moruno[/url]. If you like her art, then you might like our upcoming game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/782250/Hush_Hush__Only_Your_Love_Can_Save_Them] Hush Hush [/url]!

notes.title: It’s Today! It’s Today!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843345/0214bd61841689a4674c544a3b32700ddc09bced.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps - fancy seeing you here!

We’re pleased as punch to be announcing the official release of Cabin Fever. Yes! It’s here and it’s on sale, but only for the first week. You know what that means… The early bird gets the worm! (The worm, in this case, being a 10% discount.)

All-in-all, we had a lot of fun making this little visual novel, and we really hope you consider adding it to your collection. And if you do, we really hope you enjoy it. If we hear lots of positive feedback from players, then we might explore making more of these bite-sized VNs! 

We’ll keep it at that, simple and sweet. Thank you so much for your support, and remember…

We love you so hard!

The Pandas
